summary: The leave-taking is a blessing on the people and the country.
realLife: Reagan in 1986, Obama in 2011 and Trump in 2018 ended on God bless; Clinton asked God's blessing in other words; Roosevelt and Eisenhower ended on content with no sign-off.
sources: Read Nov 24, 2026: the first and last paragraphs of each address on the Presidency Project page; the middles were not read.
inGame: The `blessing` move in the close and the `{nation}` fact on national addresses.

turns.what: No blessing; the address ends on the point.
turns.writesBack: The last line is the ask.
